cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2, ether type); prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and Coco-Betaine (7); no reinforcing strong anionic. E3 point: no Parfum declared, first listed preservative Benzyl Alcohol (8), so 1-7 prominent; Coco-Glucoside (11) is non-prominent and not counted.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Only a weak refatter (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 6) offsets the SLES chassis; nothing argues for low under C1.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led architecture: no cationic polymer, no silicone, no payload lipid. Only a weak refatter (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 6), a pearlizer (Glycol Distearate 12) and late Glycerin (18).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate at 6 gives slight refatting feel.

weightPotential.rationale: Only deposition family is a weak refatter (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 6) plus trace Tocopherol; moderate C1 reset; no persistent system.

depositionLoad.rationale: Single weak_refatter; no polymer, silicone or payload lipid.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES chassis buffered by two betaines.

weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would need at least one plausibly persistent depositing system; none present (single family, W2 not triggered).
weightPotential.counterSignal: PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate at 6 is fairly early.
excluded: Melaleuca Alternifolia Leaf Oil (4): essential oil, 6.4

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional (claims hidden). Formula is nonspecific for lengths care; prominent tea tree oil (4) hints at a scalp/refresh role and the moderate-strength, low-conditioning, low-weight profile is F6-compatible with clarifying if oily/reset positioning appears.

careDirection.limitation: No humectant/deposition cluster; only weak refatter and late glycerin.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional default; triggers need claims (moderate cleansing cannot fire alternating).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional pending SC1 positioning. CSA formula half passes: PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (6) is a prominent E4 humectant/refatting route; no prominent E4 comfort route; prominent essential oil Melaleuca (4) is a counter-signal.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; tea tree oil does not count (Section 11).
